Bitcoin Wallet
 
 A lightweight Bitcoin wallet built on BitcoinJ 0.17.1. The application is designed to keep wallet operations local, simple, and transparent.
 
 WALLET AND TRANSACTIONS
 Your wallet data and transaction history are maintained locally by the BitcoinJ wallet engine. The application does not require a separate account or hosted wallet service.
 
 SECURITY AND BACKUPS
 Private wallet data is stored in the application’s private storage. Backups contain sensitive wallet information and should be kept in a secure location. Never share a wallet backup or private keys with anyone.
 
 NETWORK
 The application supports Bitcoin Mainnet and Bitcoin Signet. The active network is selected in Sync & Network, and each network keeps separate wallet and blockchain storage.
 
 OPEN SOURCE COMPONENT
 BitcoinJ provides the wallet and Bitcoin protocol functionality used by this application.
 
 Use the application responsibly and keep independent backups of your wallet.

WIF is the Wallet Import Format for a Bitcoin private key. It is sensitive: anyone who has it can spend the funds controlled by that key.

WIF (Wallet Import Format) is a text representation of a Bitcoin private key.
 
 Use it when you intentionally need to import an existing private key into this main wallet. Paste the WIF into the field above, then choose IMPORT PRIVATE KEY. The wallet converts it to the private key and stores it in the wallet.
 
 A WIF is not a receiving address and it is not a recovery phrase. It is secret spending authority for one private key.
 
 Never send a WIF to anyone, put it in screenshots, chat messages, cloud notes, or logs. Anyone who obtains it may be able to spend the Bitcoin controlled by that key. Only use WIF import when you know exactly where the private key came from and why it needs to be imported.
